Your vote goes to a random living player.
Your vote goes to a random living player.
Every vote cast by Kemada goes to a random living player other than the voter. The chosen vote is synchronized across the lobby. Kemada is guessable.
Keep one life safe at the cost of your own
Choose one player to protect. While you live, they cannot die. If you die, they die too.
Choose one player to protect. While you live, they cannot die. If you die, they die too.

Dirtek automatically receives one random living player at the start of the game. Protection is passive, permanent and has no cooldown or activation button. The target cannot be changed. The target dies when Dirtek dies. This protective Neutral is listed under Neutral Benign.
Bet on who will fall next
Mark players before the next round. Their deaths earn shots you can use during meetings.
Mark players before the next round. Their deaths earn shots you can use during meetings.

Gambler places marks during a meeting. Marks arm when the next round begins; marked players who are already dead do not count. The first marked death outside a meeting grants one shot. A successful Cash Out kill fulfills Gambler's win condition.
Your Cash Out shot is ready.
Activate your power for enhanced vision and personal resistance to lights and communications.
Activate your power for enhanced vision and personal resistance to lights and communications.
Empower activates Wladca's selected powers for the configured duration. Each power can be switched on or off separately in TOU-Marmo role settings. The role has its own crown and Empower icons.
Place an invisible trap. It kills the first player who enters, then disappears.
Place an invisible trap. It kills the first player who enters, then disappears.

The Composter wins with the Crewmates but can kill indirectly. Their Place Trap button creates an invisible, single-use trap at their feet. The Composter is immune to their own traps. Other players cannot see them.
Places an invisible single-use trap at your current position. It arms after a short delay and kills the first other living player who enters its radius.
Serve danger while it is hot
Kill to swap places with the farthest living player. Everyone receives an arrow to the body.
Kill to swap places with the farthest living player. Everyone receives an arrow to the body.

Barszcz is a Neutral Killing role. After Barszcz kills, every player receives an arrow pointing to the new body. At the same time, Barszcz trades positions with the farthest living player. The arrow remains until the body disappears or a meeting begins.
Kills the selected player. Everyone sees an arrow to the body, while Barszcz swaps positions with the farthest living player.
Players who interact with you wear a balloon.
Players who interact with you wear a balloon.
When another player uses a targeted ability or attempts to kill the Balloon holder, a red balloon appears above the interacting player's head for the configured duration.
Hug to kill instantly. In meetings, hug one ally for Double Shot and one enemy to kill them.
Hug to kill instantly. In meetings, hug one ally for Double Shot and one enemy to kill them.
Hugger is an Impostor Power role. In the world, Hug performs an immediate kill with the normal kill animation. Meeting hugs have separate once-per-game limits for Impostor and non-Impostor targets.

Furas wins with the Crew. Place up to the configured number of pet spawn points, choose one, then control a walking fox for a limited time. The fox uses normal movement controls and moves at 1.25 times normal player speed by default. It cannot cross walls or use vents, ladders, platforms or doors. Attacks respect shields and Dirtek protection. By default, killing a Crewmate permanently disables all Furas abilities. Options control spawn count, placement cooldown, control duration and cooldown, speed multiplier, attack range and cooldown, initial attack delay, kills per control, visibility, marker display, Comms blocking, meeting persistence and the Crewmate penalty.
Place spawn points, then control your pet. Use Pet Kill nearby. Killing a Crewmate removes your pet abilities.
Hunt through the eyes of your pet
Place spawn points, then control your pet. Use Pet Kill nearby. Killing a Crewmate removes your pet abilities.
Mark Crewmates, then reveal yourself for protection
Mark Crewmates, then reveal during a meeting for protection. Revealing too early disables marking for one round.
Mark Crewmates, then reveal during a meeting for protection. Revealing too early disables marking for one round.

Mark players to give them a one-hit shield. The mark that unlocks your reveal grants no shield. Your shields vanish when you die. An early reveal disables marking until the next meeting. Only marked living Crewmates count toward your reveal. After revealing, you become protected and can no longer mark. Voting can still eject you when enabled. You win with the Crewmates.
Steal a role for one round; still win with the Crew
Choose a nearby player. Borrow their role after the next meeting, then return it after the following meeting. You win with Crewmates.
Choose a nearby player. Borrow their role after the next meeting, then return it after the following meeting. You win with Crewmates.

Choose a living player during a round. Both roles stay unchanged through the next meeting. After it ends, you borrow their current role for one round. After the following meeting, both original roles return. If either player dies before activation, the selection is cancelled. You win with the Crewmates.
Control a corpse or send it after its killer
Control a corpse to move and kill once, or reanimate it to follow its killer. Meetings end control.
Control a corpse to move and kill once, or reanimate it to follow its killer. Meetings end control.

Control a corpse while your own body stays still, with one attack per control. Alternatively, animate a corpse to follow its killer around obstacles. Its owner remains dead. Timers, death and meetings end control. Settings govern uses, speed, reporting and Crewmate attacks.

You have two extra chances when assassinating.
You have two extra chances when assassinating.
Your first two incorrect guesses do not kill you. The third does. Requires guessing, is available to Impostors and Neutrals, and cannot coexist with Double Shot.

Protect your target from ejection to keep a shorter kill cooldown.

An Impostor-only modifier. Defend your randomly assigned player from being voted out. Your kill cooldown is 25% shorter until that happens, then the configured penalty applies. This does not give your target a shield.

Gift flowers, then reap the harvest
Kill normally. Give flowers to non-Impostors; once all are given, Pollinate rolls a kill chance on each holder.
Kill normally. Give flowers to non-Impostors; once all are given, Pollinate rolls a kill chance on each holder.

Sweets is an Impostor Power role and keeps the normal kill button. A single ability button starts as Flower and can be given to players who are not Impostor-aligned, up to the configured number. A flowered player is not told immediately - they learn about their flower at the next meeting, but never who Sweets is. Once every flower has been given, the button automatically becomes Pollinate; using it makes every active flower independently roll the configured chance to kill its holder, then all active flowers are consumed even if they fail to kill. Pollinate can be used once per game. Options control the flower cooldown, how many flowers can be given and the pollinated kill chance.
Lay the dead to rest and learn the truth
Drag bodies together and use Prayer near 3 bodies to learn a killer's identity at the next meeting.
Drag bodies together and use Prayer near 3 bodies to learn a killer's identity at the next meeting.

Exorcist can drag and drop bodies like Undertaker. When 3 bodies are within the detection radius, use Prayer to perform an exorcism. At the start of the next meeting, only the Exorcist learns the nickname and exact role of a random killer of one of those bodies. The killer must be an Impostor or Neutral Killing. If the conditions are not met, Prayer is not consumed and can be attempted again.
Exorcism complete. You will learn the truth at the next meeting.
